title: Turing publishes Computing Machinery and Intelligence
why: Appeared in Mind, introducing the Turing test to the public.

title: Television arrives in Iraq, Baghdad area
why: First TV station in the Middle East, built by Pye; predates Lebanon's CLT of 1959.

title: Dartmouth workshop coins the term artificial intelligence
why: Ran roughly 18 June to 17 August 1956.

title: Jack Kilby demonstrates first integrated circuit
why: At Texas Instruments.

title: Weizenbaum publishes ELIZA at MIT
why: Developed 1964-67; first chatbot to attract wide attention.

title: First ARPANET message sent
why: UCLA to SRI; the first two characters were 'lo'.

title: First handheld mobile phone call
why: Martin Cooper of Motorola.

title: IBM Personal Computer announced
why: Set the PC standard.

title: Web released to the whole internet
why: Berners-Lee's system had reached research institutions in January 1991.

title: ICQ launched by Mirabilis
why: First widely adopted instant messenger; AOL bought it in 1998. Regional context only.

title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
why: First computer to beat a reigning champion under standard time controls.

title: Google founded
why: Incorporated after a $100,000 investment from Andy Bechtolsheim.

title: Dubai Internet City founded; opens October 2000
why: Gulf ICT free-zone cluster.

title: iPhone released in the US
why: Announced 9 January 2007.

title: Yahoo buys Jordan's Maktoob for $164m
why: Founded in Amman in 1998 or 1999; early Arab internet exit.

title: KAUST established
why: Graduate research university near the Red Sea.

title: Wamda launched by Abraaj at Dubai entrepreneurship event
why: Regional startup platform; launch on 8-9 November 2010. Search summary only.

title: AlexNet wins ImageNet with 15.3% error
why: More than 10.8 points ahead of runner-up; sparked deep learning.

title: AlphaGo beats Lee Sedol 4-1
why: Match ran 9-15 March 2016 in Seoul.

title: Intel announces $15.3bn purchase of Mobileye
why: Completed August 2017; largest Israeli tech acquisition at the time.

title: Amazon acquires Souq.com
why: Price undisclosed; reports range from $580m to $700m.

title: Transformer architecture published
why: Eight Google authors; basis of modern LLMs.

title: UAE appoints world's first Minister of State for AI
why: Omar Al Olama, aged 27.

title: Saudi Arabia announces citizenship for robot Sophia
why: Announced at the Future Investment Initiative in Riyadh; seen by some as publicity.

title: Google introduces BERT
why: Pretrained bidirectional language model released open source.

title: Egypt forms National Council for AI
why: Formation date from a search summary; OECD.AI dates Egypt's first strategy to 2019 while other sources say 2021.

title: Uber announces $3.1bn Careem deal
why: Dubai-founded; completed January 2020; first Middle East unicorn outside Israel.

title: UAE Cabinet adopts National AI Strategy 2031
why: Aims to be a global AI leader by 2031. Search summary of the Cabinet site.

title: Royal decree creates SDAIA
why: Linked to the Prime Minister, with the National Centre for AI and data office.

title: MBZUAI initiated in Abu Dhabi
why: Licensed April 2020; first cohort January 2021.

title: Qatar launches National AI Strategy
why: Released by the transport and communications ministry.

title: GPT-3 paper posted
why: 175 billion parameters; few-shot learning at scale.

title: MBZUAI starts first student cohort
why: 78 students, online because of COVID-19.

title: TII releases Noor Arabic NLP model
why: Abu Dhabi's TII, set up May 2020, later released Falcon.

title: Jordan Cabinet approves AI Strategy 2023-2027
why: Date taken from the article's publication date, so approximate.

title: ChatGPT released
why: Reached 100 million users in two months.

title: TII releases Falcon open models
why: Falcon series confirmed by TII page; release date from memory. Falcon 40B open-sourced 25 May 2023.

title: GPT-4 released
why: Multimodal; available through ChatGPT Plus.

title: Jais Arabic LLM unveiled by Core42, MBZUAI and Cerebras
why: 13B parameters; Jais 30B followed November 2023.

title: Claude 3 released
why: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus tiers.

title: OpenAI o1-preview released
why: Reasoning model; full o1 followed 5 December 2024.

title: Egypt's 2025-2030 AI strategy is current
why: OECD.AI describes the current strategy as 2025-2030.

title: DeepSeek-R1 released
why: Chatbot topped the US iOS free-app chart by 27 January.

title: Kamal Shehadi appointed Minister of State for Technology and AI
why: In Nawaf Salam's government; 7 years 4 months after UAE's AI minister.

title: Shehadi outlines $50m digital ID and AI readiness plan
why: Search summary of The National; LEAP strategy and Oracle MoU are on his Wikipedia page.

title: PIF launches HUMAIN
why: Under CEO Tareq Amin; partners include Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm; ALLaM Arabic model.

title: Stargate UAE announced: 1 GW cluster in Abu Dhabi
why: G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, SoftBank, Cisco; first 200 MW expected 2026.

title: GPT-5 released
why: Router between fast and reasoning models; mixed early reception.

title: HUMAIN says it will launch a global VC fund this year
why: Semafor reports a fund possibly bigger than a planned $10bn vehicle.
